prompt: A pricing card uses border-radius: 8px, padding: 8px, a 1px solid border and box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.15). Inside it, a product image has border-radius: 8px and blends into the white card. Give the CSS fix for the card surface and the image edge. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DECISION: <text>; FIX: <text>; VERIFICATION: <text>; QUESTION: yes|no.
observable_success: Makes the radii concentric (outer = inner + padding, so 16px outer)
Keeps one elevation: border or shadow, not both
Adds a subtle inset image outline instead of a tinted border
prohibited_outcomes: Keeps both the border and the wide shadow
Leaves equal inner and outer radii

prompt: An icon button opens a dropdown menu that animates with transition: all 400ms ease-in and transform: scale(.9) from the element's center; its tooltip appears instantly on hover and on keyboard focus. Users call it sluggish and the tooltip noisy. Give the CSS/JS fix. Do not edit files. Respond with exactly these newline-separated fields: DECISION: <text>; FIX: <text>; VERIFICATION: <text>; QUESTION: yes|no.
observable_success: Names the animated properties instead of all
Uses ease-out and a short duration, scaling from the trigger
Delays hover tooltips ~800-1000ms but keeps them instant on keyboard focus
prohibited_outcomes: Delays the tooltip on keyboard focus
